entries.03700b5a7da63d66: For construction and packaging, Daito Steel Co., Ltd. is listed under Related Information as a major customer. For electrical and transportation equipment, the main targets are customers in automobiles, industrial equipment, control equipment and precision parts. The business risks described in the annual securities report cite, as a long-term risk, a decline in nail demand due to a decrease in new housing starts, and, for electrical and transportation equipment, the effect on exports of automobiles if the number of exported vehicles falls due to trade policy.

entries.2bd0038b8f8eb9bb: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥235 million (down 1.4% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥223 million (up 2.2% year on year), and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥147 million (up 3.7% year on year).
entries.311f6a7beb96a423: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,374 million (down 3.7% year on year). Construction and packaging revenue was ¥3,808 million (down 4.0% year on year), as lower new housing starts reduced nail demand and the company's sales volume also fell from the previous year. Electrical and transportation equipment revenue was ¥1,566 million (down 3.0% year on year), reflecting the effect of production adjustments by some sales customers in the automotive industry.
entries.3794e11d035e1c24: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥235 million (down 1.4% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥223 million (up 2.2% year on year), and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥147 million (up 3.7% year on year). Gross profit was ¥1,004 million (down 3.7% year on year). The annual securities report states that, even though sales volume fell, cost control through production management matched to demand, productivity improvements and yield improvement kept the gross profit margin at 18.7%, the same as the previous year. Segment operating profit was ¥320 million for construction and packaging and ¥113 million for electrical and transportation equipment.

entries.6aed25b1d7d5da80: A reportable segment that manufactures, procures, and sells common nails, special nails, various types of collated nails, building materials, nail guns, and similar products; of the 2 reportable segments, it is the one with the larger sales to external customers. The Company is in charge of it. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥3,808 million (down 4.0% from the same period of the previous year), and segment operating profit was ¥320 million (down 0.2%). The securities report states that demand for nails fell because of the decrease in new housing starts and the Company's sales volume also fell from the previous fiscal year, while wooden buildings in the non-residential field tend to increase under the policy of using domestic timber. Profit stayed almost level with the previous fiscal year through optimization of the product mix between overseas OEM products and domestically produced products and through fixed cost reductions.

entries.7e727c751e1c64f4: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the company group consists of the company, which mainly manufactures, procures and sells plain nails, special nails, various connected nails, building materials, and nail guns for "construction and packaging," one subsidiary (Natec Co., Ltd.), and two other affiliates (Itochu Marubeni Steel Corporation and Kobe Steel, Ltd.) (as of March 31, 2026). The subsidiary Natec Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells precision equipment screws, automotive parts screws, resin screws and the like for "electrical and transportation equipment." The company procures its main raw material, wire rod, from Kobe Steel, Ltd. and others, through Itochu Marubeni Steel Corporation. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,374 million (down 3.7% year on year), of which ¥3,808 million was for construction and packaging and ¥1,566 million was for electrical and transportation equipment.

entries.8a61df20e853d51e: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells screws for precision equipment, screws for automotive parts, screws for resin, and similar products. It is handled by the consolidated subsidiary Natec Co., Ltd. (Soka, Saitama Prefecture; 100.00% of the Company's voting rights). Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,566 million (down 3.0% from the same period of the previous year), and segment operating profit was ¥113 million (down 11.4%). The securities report states that production at major customers was relatively steady, but some customers in the automotive industry were affected by production adjustments. Demand was solid for licensed products, parts former products, and bolts and special fasteners used in motors and electrification components for hybrid and electric vehicles and in autonomous driving and electronic control devices.

entries.f19250dc326160c5: It makes common nails, special nails and various collated nails used in construction and packing, as well as building materials and nail guns, and makes precision equipment screws, automotive parts screws and resin screws for electrical and transport equipment. As its management policy, it writes that about 8 tenths of total domestic demand for nails is met by imported products, but considering growing environmental awareness and overseas conditions, the company intends to mainly supply domestically produced products to customers, and also handle overseas contract-manufactured products (OEM products), aiming to respond from general-purpose products to high-value-added products.
